items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: when I got away from that jury store, I went and played at Hans, and they had this fellow, Josh Jones, on Basin Street... Mel Bryant, and Frantz Alambritz, and May Tucker... all through that Iverville Street.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, he's still a little small. He's pretty short, but he's got a stomach.

Yeah. Well, I must give him what's coming to him. He had a good lift. He did. If I'm mistaken, I believe Mal Flores showed him. If I'm mistaken, I believe it is. Mal Flores showed him. And, of course, he came out to be good. He's one out of 100. My brother used to say, you know something between him and Bunk, I don't know which one I'm scared of. He said, all right. He said, because Bunk plays that maple leaf rag with such a nice tone, and it comes out, and he figured that corner's so good, he said, this fellow…
